title: Register as a building contractor
what: Register as a building contractor before carrying out builder work that needs a building permit and is worth $20,000 or more ($50,000 for sheds, garages and similar).

sources.title: Do I need to be a registered building contractor?

marks.reason: A licence with qualification or experience tests is needed before contracting.
